section-2.security: Security: Thou art responsible for guarding the secrecy of thy account credentials, including passwords and Two-Factor Authentication (TOTP/Backup codes), if enabled. Thou art answerable for all deeds that occur under thy account.

section-3.prohibited-3: Scrape, crawl, or mass-download lessons, problems, or other proprietary content without our express written leave.

Thou mayst not distribute, reproduce, or create derivative works from our content without leave.

privacy-page.intro: At Codium, we are committed to protecting your privacy. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you visit our platform.
privacy-page.section-1-desc: We collect information that you provide directly to us and data gathered automatically when you use our Service:

section-1.personal-info: Personal Information: When you register, we collect your email address, username, password (stored securely as a hash), and optionally a profile picture.
section-1.usage-data: Usage Data & Progress: We track your interaction with the Service, including completed lessons, coding problem solutions, test results, bookmarks, and user permissions/roles (e.g., admin status).
section-1.technical-data: Technical Data: We automatically collect standard technical information, such as your IP address, browser type, device information, and interactions with our web pages.

privacy-page.section-2-desc: We use the collected information for the following purposes:

section-2.use-1: To provide, operate, and maintain the Codium platform (e.g., authenticating your login, running your code submissions, tracking your progress).
section-2.use-2: To improve our educational content and compiler infrastructure.
section-2.use-3: To communicate with you, including sending account verification emails, password resets, and important service updates.
section-2.use-4: To ensure the security of our platform and prevent fraudulent or malicious activity (e.g., bot detection).

privacy-page.section-3-desc: Codium uses cookies and similar tracking technologies (such as JSON Web Tokens/Refresh Tokens) to maintain your session, remember your preferences, and keep you logged securely into your account. You can control cookie preferences through your browser settings, but disabling them may affect your ability to use authenticated features.
privacy-page.section-4-desc: We do not sell, trade, or rent your personal information to third parties. We may share your information only in the following situations:

section-4.share-1: Service Providers: With trusted third-party services that assist us in operating our platform (e.g., email delivery services for validation emails, cloud hosting providers), under strict confidentiality agreements.
section-4.share-2: Legal Compliance: If required by law, subpoena, or other legal processes, or to protect the rights, property, or safety of Codium, our users, or others.

privacy-page.section-5-desc: We implement standard security measures to protect your personal information, including encrypting passwords and securing database access. However, no electronic transmission over the internet or information storage technology can be guaranteed to be 100% secure.
privacy-page.section-6-desc: Depending on your location, you may have the right to:

section-6.right-1: Access the personal data we hold about you.
section-6.right-2: Request the correction of inaccurate data.
section-6.right-3: Request the deletion of your account and associated data (including your code solutions and progress).

privacy-page.section-6-footer: To exercise these rights, please contact us using the information below.
privacy-page.section-7-desc: Codium is not intentionally directed to children under the age of 13. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If we become aware that we have collected such data, we will take steps to delete it.
privacy-page.section-8-desc: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated "Effective Date." We encourage you to review this policy periodically.
privacy-page.section-9-desc: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or our data practices, please contact us at: [Insert Contact Email].
